recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce duplicate extension definitions into core; future changes to these extensions should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack or related IG Publisher/SUSHI tooling.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core request to add resource instance name and description extensions for publication use, populating ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.name and .description, with appearance constraints preventing use where a proper title/description slot already exists.
initial_application: Core commit 02d97e2292 added resource-instance-name and resource-instance-description StructureDefinitions and Resource-core IG references for FHIR-29406. The description extension initially had a copied fixedUri pointing at resource-instance-name. Commit dd468d4f17 later removed extension definitions from R5 core source as extensions moved out of the core repository.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2020-11-02 and 2020-11-09 confirm the original approval and reopened modified approval. The original Zulip thread motivated carrying example names/descriptions in source resources; a 2023 Zulip follow-up and FHIR-42968 clarify that the official current Extension Pack names are resource-instance-name and resource-instance-description. FHIR-40817 corrected the description fixedUri in the Extension Pack.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Current core has no active source definitions for these extensions beyond source/oids.ini entries, while /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Resource contains active resource-instance-name and resource-instance-description definitions with the requested purpose and constraints. Because the authoritative source is outside this FHIR core checkout, the combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit.
